scope: WP-07 loss, mining, block scoring, and full-gallery evaluation software; synthetic tests only, not an SLRet experiment

evidence: Original paired ID is the only positive.
Off-diagonal exact-caption duplicates are excluded from denominators.
Row and column candidates are mined from their declared directional matrices.
The pair union deduplicates computation but never expands an anchor denominator.
A batch anchor without a real eligible negative fails closed.
Dense and block pair scoring match in loss, token gradients, and one SGD update.
Externally scaled logits enter InfoNCE without an additional temperature.
Base and mixed two-direction losses are each composed exactly once.
Both score matrices use [video,text] orientation and remain separate.
Permuted video/text IDs map targets by ID rather than diagonal array position.
Primary exact ties sort by score descending then canonical candidate ID ascending.
Optimistic, pessimistic, and one-weight-per-query expected tie recalls are reported.
VideoIndex has no caption field or caption constructor argument.
Changing/deleting candidate-video annotation captions after index construction leaves T2V scores unchanged.
Block scorer initializes scores as missing and requires every Cartesian pair to be filled.
Missing or non-finite scores fail instead of being zero-filled.
Dense and multi-block directional matrices are identical on the fixture.

deferred.DDP_01: One-GPU MVP is locked first; gradient-preserving multi-process layout remains a WP-11 optimization and cannot be claimed yet.
